title: Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish with tender lamb and aromatic spices.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in the bottom of a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice mix and stir to combine.
Add the olives and parsley, and stir to combine.
Add the tagine sauce and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
